creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
ven_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
ven_login = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=ven_pw)
print('venmo login', ven_login)
ven_token = ven_login['access_token']

# Get yesterday and today from phone API
now = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
cur_dt = datetime.strptime(now['date'], '%A, %B %d, %Y')
yesterday = (cur_dt - timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
start = (cur_dt - timedelta(days=2)).date().isoformat()
end = cur_dt.date().isoformat()
print('date range', start, end)

# shares list from note 3084
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0])['access_token'])
shares=[]
for line in note['content'].splitlines():
    if '=>' in line:
        parts=line.split('=>')
        name=parts[0].strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
        amt=float(parts[1].strip().replace('$',''))
        shares.append((name, amt))
print('shares', shares)
share_amounts=set([amt for _,amt in shares])

# Fetch received transactions in date range
tx=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=ven_token, direction='received', min_created_at=start, max_created_at=end, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    tx.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total transactions fetched',len(tx))
# Filter to those amounts match our shares (exact cents)
matched=[]
for t in tx:
    amt=round(float(t['amount']),2)
    if amt in set([round(x,2) for x in share_amounts]):
        matched.append(t)
print('matched by amount',len(matched))
# Print matched transaction summaries
for t in sorted(matched, key=lambda x:x['created_at'], reverse=True)[:30]:
    print({'id':t['transaction_id'], 'amount':t['amount'], 'created_at':t['created_at'], 'desc':t['description'], 'sender':t['sender'], 'receiver':t['receiver']})

# Find notes with 'Friends Dinner' in title/query and pick the one closest to dinner (prefer updated/created on cur_iso)
query = 'Friends Dinner'

    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
